purpose: Create the first consumer-visible N0TE2 front door: a context-safe Artist Headquarters shell that uses existing profile/runtime/Headquarters semantics, lets a normal local consumer create/select a healthy Artist profile, understand whether there is an active Song, start or resume that Song, navigate bounded Headquarters surfaces without losing context, and explicitly quit without developer tools.

lineage.outcome: A normal artist reaches a real Artist Headquarters first, sees their own Song state in artist language, can start/resume creative work, navigate without context loss and quit cleanly without configuring unrelated infrastructure.
lineage.capability: Artist Headquarters front door and context-safe bounded navigation

n0te2_dependencies: CORE-01 canonical HeadquartersMemory/LineageStore Artist and Song identity
legacy_rejections: raw IDs/JSON/registry/provider/debug internals in primary UX
force DAW/provider/AI setup before an artist can start
one profile inheriting another Artist World
browser tab close treated as application quit
UI-only fake Song state disconnected from canonical Headquarters
framework choice promoted to product doctrine

completion_proof: consumer shell is reachable only through loopback-local ownership and does not expose a LAN/network control surface by default
write actions require an unguessable shell-session token and reject foreign Origin/Host authority; no permissive CORS or unauthenticated localhost mutation endpoint is introduced
profile discovery/creation/selection reuses ApplicationProfiles and never fabricates or merges Artist identities; healthy multiple-profile state requires explicit selection

launch reuses ApplicationRuntime and the canonical selected profile; another live owner, uncertain ownership or recovery state is shown as an understandable non-destructive consumer state rather than stolen
Artist Headquarters primary rendering uses artist/job vocabulary and does not surface raw profile/Song IDs, JSON, stack traces, transport/registry internals or provider plumbing

no-Song state offers a bounded Start a Song action backed by the canonical Headquarters store; active-Song state offers Resume and displays human Song title/status without creating a parallel UI-only Song object
bounded Home/Song/Now/Settings navigation preserves the same selected Artist and active Song context; navigation itself performs no unrelated business/provider mutation
DAW/AI/provider setup is absent from the primary first-run requirement path and remains contextual/skippable until a downstream job needs it
representative empty/selection/busy/uncertain/recovery states are understandable and actionable without developer vocabulary

basic accessibility is structural: semantic landmarks/headings/labels, keyboard-reachable controls, visible focus, non-color-only status, reduced-motion support, scalable responsive layout and comfortable targets
explicit Quit closes canonical Headquarters/releases the exact ApplicationRuntime profile lease and stops/releases the shell listener; closing a browser tab alone is not falsely recorded as N0TE quit
cross-profile tests prove shell state for one Artist never renders another profile's Artist/Song data unless that profile is explicitly selected and launched

consumer smoke proves a fresh local path from no profile or selected healthy profile -> Headquarters -> Start/Resume Song -> navigate away/back with context intact -> explicit Quit -> clean relaunch to the same durable Artist/Song state
non_scope: Focus modes beyond truthful placeholder/navigation affordance
next_selection_rule: After UX-01A is implemented, red-teamed and consumer-proven, audit UX-01 remaining requirements by consumer outcome. Continue with the highest-leverage bounded UX increment rather than drifting into DAW/AUDIO/OPS seams or claiming UX-01 complete from one front-door shell.
